_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - never put a real key in this file, and never commit one. The app reads its real config from ~/.trading-copilot-config.json (outside this repo), or from the matching environment variables. Updated 2026-09-21: the providers below are the ones the app actually talks to. Anthropic, Groq, OmniRoute and local Ollama were removed on 2026-09-02 - see CLAUDE.md's ONE AI BACKEND section and app/provider-chain.js.
_gemini_comment: Break-glass only. If the DeepSeek key is absent, empty, or kill-switched, Gemini answers instead - and every reply that comes from it is alarmed in the UI, because a different vendor answering as the coach (including on the Judge path that can emit a TRADE_TICKET) must never be silent. Set disableDeepSeek to drop to the backup mid-session without deleting a paid key.
_edgeVoice_comment: Text-to-speech: Edge neural, falling back to local Windows SAPI and then the browser's own voice. Speech-to-text is the browser's Web Speech API. No speech vendor and no audio API key are involved.
_openRouter_comment: Only needed for the TypeSafe shadow layer (app/typesafe-*.js), which is OFF until this key exists. It is a spend guard as much as a feature flag.
